title: MITRE-funded papers detecting gravitons near atmosphere

tellings.quote: However, there are papers that have since that were funded by the MITRE Corporation going back 20, 25 years that show that gravitons were both very high frequency and extremely low frequency gravitons were detectable near the Earth's atmosphere.

plain: Dave Rossi, a researcher who says he learned advanced physics in unusual ways, says on podcast host Jesse Michels' show that the MITRE Corporation, an American research company that does work for the government, funded scientific papers going back 20 to 25 years. According to Rossi, those papers show that gravitons, the tiny particles some physicists think carry the force of gravity, could be detected near Earth's atmosphere at both very high and very low frequencies. If so, it would mean gravity was being studied in secret ways long before the public knew.
